name: Csátalja (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csátalja: a crowned quartered shield of green, red and blue with a bunch of grapes, a saint, a plough and a white bird, with blue and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csátalja arms with crown and mantling
